1.consolidated_definition: Exigir a alguien el máximo esfuerzo de forma continua y sin tregua. A mi hijo lo tengo al palo. Ya se lo he dicho: si quiere ser cantante, tiene que estudiar; si quiere ser bailarín, tiene que estudiar; si quiere ser barbero o lo que sea, tiene que estudiar. (Primera Hora, 14-11-15)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To demand the utmost effort from someone continuously and without respite.

To keep someone on a tight rein. I've already told my son: if he wants to be a singer, he has to study; if he wants to be a dancer, he has to study; if he wants to be a barber or whatever it is, he has to study.
